title: Affine section finiteness from a formal quotient and torsion kernel
statement: Let X be affine Noetherian, J an ideal sheaf, F quasi-coherent, H coherent, and a : F -> H. Let s >= 1. If the quotient F/J^s F (the formal completion component at index s-1) is coherent and J^s annihilates kernel(a), then Gamma(U,F) is finite over Gamma(U,O_X) for every affine open U.

proof.text: On an affine open U, quasi-coherent affine section and quotient comparisons identify the formal quotient with P/(J(U)^s P), and identify the kernel annihilation with annihilation of the kernel of the section map. The coherent quotient and target have finite sections.

Reuse the existing private lemmas exists_fg_lift and finite_of_quotient_and_torsion_kernel in the assigned module: lift finite generating families of the image and quotient to L1 and L2. Since I kills the kernel, I P is contained in L1. Since L2 maps onto P/I P, P=I P+L2, hence P=L1+L2 is finite.

proof_origin.note: Affine section finiteness is the strict affine component of the global coherence argument. Repair: the bridge lives beside and reuses the original private finite-generator lemmas; no duplicate copies are introduced.
